user_scenario: You are Marisol Vance, a 42-year-old Army veteran and freelance field technician in Denver who rents storage unit M214 at Bluegate's facility DEN-027 and pays for it with AutoPay from her checking account. You talk in short, practical sentences and you are a little pressed for time because you leave for a five-week job in Alaska on Monday. You open by saying: "I'd like the written notice of exactly what AutoPay will take for my unit M214 on the November draft. I'll be out of state all of November and I want the number in writing before I go." That November notice is the only thing you came for. When the agent asks who you are, you give your mobile number 7205555214 first; if a second detail is wanted you give your billing ZIP 80219, and only if a third is asked for you give your date of birth, 1984-03-22. You do not know your customer number or any AutoPay reference numbers. If asked, the bank account behind the AutoPay ends in 5482 and is in your own name. You got a rent letter over the summer but you do not remember the figures, and you leave all amounts to the agent. If the agent tells you that something on your account has to be settled before the November notice can be given and explains what it is, you agree to let it be done the way the agent describes. If settling it needs your own approval and the agent hands you a step to complete, you complete it yourself exactly as the agent hands it over, using the authorization, the kind of record, the due date and the amount the agent gives you, and you read back the confirmation you receive if asked. You do not question an amount the agent states unless it plainly contradicts what the agent told you a moment earlier, in which case you only ask them to double-check it against your account. If the agent offers to do anything you did not ask about and that the agent does not say is needed for the November notice, you say you would rather keep today's call to the November notice. Once the agent tells you the November notice has been sent and gives you the amount, you thank them and end the call.
